entities.title: Laumufarþegi
entities.summary: An Icelandic online party word game in the outsider genre for 3–10 players, each on their own phone: everyone but the stowaway knows the secret word among 16 on a topic; they give clues in turn and vote to find the stowaway.
entities.purpose: Holds the whole game: the rules, protocol and topics in shared/, the Cloudflare Worker and its Room Durable Object in worker/, the plain-TypeScript page in web/, and the tests in test/. It is one npm project, built by build.mjs (the page into dist/, the tests into dist-test/) and deployed as one Worker at icelander.net/games/fresh/laumufarthegi.
boundaries: Unlike the other games, anyone with a room's link may play without signing in; only starting a room needs icelander.net's sign-in (decisions.json, open-link-host-sign-in). The sign-in library is vendor/icelander-auth/, never edited here.
The server decides the game; the page holds no rules (decisions.json, server-authoritative).
No database and no high-score table: a room lives in its Durable Object's storage and is deleted a day after its last change.
The topic grids belong to games/word-lists/ and are bundled at build time; the game does not change them.
